panel_contract.partition_rule: Within each selected logical seismic file/member, preserve source trace/channel order. Split consecutive channels into groups of up to 128 and consecutive time samples into non-overlapping groups of up to 8192. Partial final channel/time groups are retained; no sample is dropped or duplicated.
panel_contract.dtype: preserve source integer/float semantics; engines may internally use float32/float64
panel_contract.epsilon: 0.10 * global standard deviation of all selected numeric samples in the survey
panel_contract.fair_baseline_rule: Our portfolio and SZ3 receive exactly the same numeric panel partition and the same survey-global epsilon.

selector.rule: screen every frozen candidate on the same prefix; choose the candidate with the fewest charged bytes per sample; encode the complete panel only with that candidate; ties use the lower candidate id
selector.short_final_panel_rule: If a retained final panel has 32 or fewer time samples, candidates whose model cannot be fit are marked invalid and the smallest actual stream among the remaining valid frozen candidates is chosen. No sample is dropped.
selector.note: Land/marine/DAS labels never select a codec. The decoder receives the selected candidate id in the charged portfolio header.

candidates.name: Huber AR32 + zero/sign/Elias-gamma adaptive arithmetic
candidates.quantizer: integer source: floor(2*epsilon) integer step and integer-rounded predictor; float source: nextafter(2*epsilon,0) floating step
